Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a grant program for facilities for youth-oriented activities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the construction or improvement of public schooldistrict facilities for youthoriented activities; and adding a newsection to chapter 28A.300 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.300RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A competitive grant program is created to assist nonprofitorganizations in improving or constructing public school districtfacilities for the purpose of operating youthoriented activityprograms. Subject to the availability of funds appropriated for thispurpose in the capital budget, the superintendent of public instructionshall allocate up to five grants per fiscal year to private nonprofitorganizations. (2) The superintendent of public instruction shall conduct astatewide solicitation of applications from private nonprofitorganizations that operate youthoriented activities, as determined bythe superintendent. (3) Applications under this section must be for the improvement or p. 1 HB 1948construction of facilities on public school district property thatwould enable, or enhance the ability of, the applying organizations tooperate youthoriented activity programs. (4) The superintendent of public instruction shall establish andpublish criteria for evaluating applications received under thissection. The criteria shall give priority to organizations whoseprograms target underserved, disadvantaged, or multiculturalpopulations. (5) All statutes and rules applicable to use of public schooldistrict facilities, including RCW 28A.335.150 and 28A.335.155, shallapply to all such facilities constructed or improved by a nonprofitorganization using a grant under this section.
